articles.title: Kansas City blow: Travis Kelce ankle injury takes worrying turn before Broncos game
articles.standfirst: Travis Kelce’s injury scare is raising concerns in Kansas City as the Chiefs prepare for a crucial AFC West showdown against the Broncos.
articles.summary: Travis Kelce’s injury scare is raising concerns in Kansas City as the Chiefs prepare for a crucial AFC West showdown against the Broncos.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs are trying to move past their first loss of the season, a painful 20-3 defeat to the defending Super Bowl champions, the Seattle Seahawks , in a game in which the offense managed just three points.

However, concerns grew in Kansas City ahead of another key AFC West matchup against the Denver Broncos . The team reported that Travis Kelce returned to the injury report after limited participation in Thursday’s practice due to an ankle issue.

The situation drew attention because just one day earlier the future Hall of Famer had practiced without restrictions. While it is not a new injury, it serves as a reminder that the veteran tight end continues to deal with physical discomfort.

In addition to Kelce , Rashee Rice , L’Jarius Sneed , and Omarr Norman-Lott also practiced on a limited basis, while cornerback Mansoor Delane did not practice due to a shoulder injury.

The injury that continues to bother Kelce

The ankle problem originated in the first quarter of the Chiefs’ 22-6 victory over the Los Angeles Chargers on October 18 .

After catching a screen pass, Kelce was brought down by linebacker Daiyan Henley with a hip-drop tackle. On the play, the defender’s shoulder struck the tight end’s right ankle directly.

Kelce briefly left the field limping while being attended to by the medical staff, who immobilized and taped the joint. Despite the hit, he returned to the game and finished with four receptions for 53 yards.

After the contest, Andy Reid downplayed the situation, explaining that Kelce had simply “tweaked his ankle.” Former NFL doctor David Chao later analyzed the play and described it as a mild high eversion sprain, an injury that typically allows a player to compete when the ankle is properly stabilized.

Kelce played last week against Seattle despite limited practice for several days, though his production again suffered. He finished with four catches for 44 yards in the loss to the Seahawks — only the second time this season he has failed to surpass 50 receiving yards.

Even so, he tied Noah Gray for the team lead in receiving yards and reached another historic milestone by surpassing Marvin Harrison and Cris Carter to move into fifth place on the NFL’s all-time receptions list.

Will he be available against Denver?

Kelce remains on the official injury report, and his final status will be determined after Friday’s practice.

For now, all indications suggest he will once again be available to face the Broncos, just as he was last week against Seattle.

In the first meeting of the season against Denver, the veteran posted 71 receiving yards , and the Chiefs hope to have their primary offensive weapon available in a game that could shape the race for the AFC West.

Kansas City enters the matchup at 5-1 , just one game ahead of the 5-2 Broncos, giving the contest significant weight in the battle for the top of the division.

Kelce approaches the game with a career total of 1,104 receptions, 13,345 receiving yards, and 84 touchdowns in the regular season. In 2026 he has recorded 24 catches for 343 yards and two scores.

A three-time Super Bowl champion, 11-time Pro Bowler, and four-time All-Pro, Kelce also holds the tight end records for most 1,000-yard seasons (7) and most receiving yards in a single season (1,416 in 2020).

Off the field, the tight end married Taylor Swift on July 3 at Madison Square Garden. The singer was present at Arrowhead Stadium when Kelce suffered the ankle scare against the Chargers, though she has not made any public comments about the injury since.

articles.title: "Dumbest thing I've ever seen": Jason and Travis Kelce slam NFL referees
articles.standfirst: The Kelce brothers have questioned the officials' decision to penalise New York Giants running back Cam Skattebo after a collision with Houston Texans safety M.J. Stewart
articles.summary: The Kelce brothers have questioned the officials' decision to penalise New York Giants running back Cam Skattebo after a collision with Houston Texans safety M.J. Stewart
articles.body:
J ason and Travis Kelce have joined the growing criticism of NFL officials after a controversial call against New York Giants running back Cam Skattebo during the team's Week 7 victory over the Houston Texans .

The incident became a talking point on the latest episode of the brothers' New Heights podcast, where the former Philadelphia Eagles centre and Kansas City Chiefs tight end discussed the unnecessary roughness penalty handed to Skattebo .

The Giants running back was penalised in the first quarter after lowering his helmet into Texans safety M.J. Stewart while attempting to gain additional yards. Officials ruled that he had initiated contact with the crown of his helmet, resulting in a 15-yard penalty and wiping out a seven-yard gain.

Travis admitted that he struggled to understand precisely what the officials had seen.

“I just don’t get it, man,” the Chiefs tight end said. “… Was it the crown of the helmet thing? Had to be, right?”

Jason was considerably less restrained in his response, questioning the decision and expressing frustration with the way the league applies its rules.

“That’s the [expletive] dumbest goddamn thing I’ve ever seen. It’s [expletive] stupid,” declared the Philadelphia Eagles legend.

“Yeah, that sucks,” Travis Kelce agreed.

The discussion reflects a wider debate about how running backs are expected to protect themselves while also avoiding dangerous helmet contact. Skattebo is known for his physical approach, regularly using his strength to break tackles and drive through defenders.

Why Cam Skattebo's penalty has caused such a reaction

The call was particularly contentious because the contact occurred during a conventional running play, with Skattebo lowering his body as he prepared to meet Stewart.

Giants head coach John Harbaugh also questioned the decision immediately after it happened, arguing that the league needed to consider the physical demands placed on running backs.

Harbaugh subsequently explained that avoiding all head movement during contact is difficult for a player carrying the ball low to the ground. He wanted greater clarity from the NFL about how the rule should be interpreted in situations like this.

Skattebo himself was not prepared to change his playing style simply because of the penalty.

After the game, he expressed frustration with what he viewed as inconsistent treatment of his physical running, suggesting he would accept the consequences rather than stop playing aggressively.

The NFL's rules prohibit players from using the crown of their helmets to make forcible contact with an opponent. The intention is to reduce the risk of serious head and neck injuries, protecting both the player delivering the contact and the opponent.

However, the Skattebo incident has raised questions about how that rule should be applied when a running back is bracing for a tackle.

Despite the controversial moment, the Giants went on to secure an impressive 27-21 overtime victory in Houston. Skattebo finished with a career-best 124 rushing yards and a touchdown on 17 carries, while his 42-yard run in overtime helped put New York in position for the decisive score.

The penalty therefore did not prevent the Giants from leaving Houston with the win, but it has continued to attract attention in the days since the game.

The NFL could still review the play when considering potential disciplinary action. Skattebo has previously faced scrutiny over his use of the helmet, making the league's eventual decision particularly relevant to how he approaches future games.

Meanwhile, the Chiefs have their own priorities after suffering their first defeat of the season in Week 7, losing 20-3 to the defending champions, the Seattle Seahawks. Kansas City fell to 5-1 but remains in contention at the top of the AFC West.

Travis and his teammates will now look to respond against division rivals the Denver Broncos. Jason, meanwhile, has made his position on the Skattebo decision unmistakably clear: he believes the officials got it badly wrong.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes catches daughter Golden doing the trick she has mastered
articles.standfirst: Patrick Mahomes’ wife shared an adorable photo of her youngest daughter, who is beginning to master an art of her own.
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes’ wife shared an adorable photo of her youngest daughter, who is beginning to master an art of her own.
articles.body:
A little star in front of the camera! Brittany Mahomes shared a photo of her daughter Golden wearing a princess dress and flashing a smile that caught her attention . The picture came with a sweet caption revealing just how delighted she is to see her little girl getting better and better at posing for pictures.

“She’s getting the cheese down”, Patrick Mahomes’ wife wrote, also tagging him in the post.

The Mahomes family is already enjoying Halloween season

Golden’s photo came amid several fall-themed moments Brittany has shared with her followers. With Halloween just around the corner, the family has been making the most of the season with a few festive activities .

Earlier that same week, the businesswoman posted pictures from a visit to a pumpkin patch with Patrick and their three children: Sterling, five, Bronze, three, and Golden.

In one of the photos, the little ones posed on a haystack surrounded by pumpkins. They also enjoyed an animal-themed carousel, while Sterling posed next to bear figures beneath the decorative lights hanging from the trees.

Brittany also shows her support for Patrick Mahomes

The family posts have also offered glimpses of how Brittany and their children support Patrick throughout his season with the Kansas City Chiefs .

On October 21, she shared several photos of herself and the kids cheering on the quarterback during a game. “The best times”, she captioned the pictures .

As Patrick continues his NFL commitments, Brittany keeps sharing some of the special moments she enjoys with their little ones.

articles.title: Tyreek Hill raises further doubts among the Chiefs about his recovery after traveling to Germany to see a renowned doctor
articles.standfirst: Could Kansas City move on and sign another wide receiver in the 2026 NFL season?
articles.summary: Could Kansas City move on and sign another wide receiver in the 2026 NFL season?
articles.body:
T yreek Hill 's latest attempt to accelerate his recovery has taken him to Germany , where the former Kansas City Chiefs receiver is receiving treatment for his injured knee as doubts about his ability to take to the field in the 2026 NFL season continue to grow. The 32-year-old’s continued rehabilitation without a team is creating uncertainty to the extent of his ability to play football and the eight-time Pro Bowler shared footage from Munich on Snapchat , adding the location tag and the word, "Treatment."

Another video showed renowned physician Dr. Hans-Wilhelm Muller-Wohlfahrt working on Hill 's knee, although the visit does not establish whether he might be ready to play in the coming weeks despite the claims of his agent. Hill has been a free agent since Miami released him before the start of the offseason as he suffered a serious left knee injury against the New York whilst playing for the Dolphins , dislocating the joint and tearing multiple ligaments, including his ACL. Following two operations, he said he still needed to rebuild strength in his leg and Drew Rosenhaus has spoken with several teams about signing his client, but acknowledged there was "nothing immediate" available. Muller-Wohlfahrt is a familiar name in elite sport as he served as Bayern Munich 's team doctor for more than 40 years in soccer and worked with the German national team between 1995 and 2018.

Have the Chiefs moved on with their wide receiver search?

Hill 's previous production explains why teams might still consider taking a chance. He recorded more than 1000 receiving yards in six seasons with the Chiefs and Dolphins , won Super Bowl LIV . He has accumulated 11,363 receiving yards and 83 touchdowns. However, his recovery is not the only uncertainty surrounding his future. In October 2026, a civil jury found Hill liable for two counts of battery in a case brought by his estranged wife, Lakeeta Vaccaro , awarding her $500,000 in compensatory damages. Vaccaro accused him of physical and emotional abuse during their relationship and marriage. He disputed most allegations, and the jury rejected eight of her claims while finding him responsible for two incidents. He acknowledged pushing her against a wall during one confrontation and admitted making threatening remarks and the NFL confirmed it was monitoring developments after the verdict, opening the door to a potential suspension. Kansas City has other priorities as the November 10 trade deadline approaches and ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler said the Chiefs have "multiple lines in the water" as they explore ways to strengthen their receiving corps. Fowler mentioned Brian Thomas Jr. and Josh Downs as potential trade names, although he did not specifically connect either player to Kansas City whilst Rashod Bateman , Jerry Jeudy , Jauan Jennings and Chris Godwin are also options. Kansas City needs a receiver capable of stretching defenses vertically after Tyquan Thornton 's injury against the Las Vegas Raiders , sidelining the speedster until the NFL Playoffs at the earliest.

articles.title: Andy Reid can’t hide his joy when Travis Kelce surprises him with a cheeseburger
articles.summary: Andy Reid’s love for cheeseburgers gets the spotlight in a playful new video from the Chiefs.
articles.body:
Andy Reid’s love for cheeseburgers gets the spotlight in a playful new video from the Chiefs.

In one scene, Travis Kelce hands Reid a wrapped box that looks like it might hold a pair of sneakers. When the coach opens it and finds a cheeseburger instead, his teammates celebrate and Reid can’t hide how happy he is.

Patrick Mahomes also joins the fun as the players turn Reid’s well-known favorite into a running joke. The best part is the coach’s reaction: even a surprise burger can bring out a big smile from Big Red.

articles.title: The Chiefs are close to landing a new WR from the Colts, but the Steelers could put an end to the negotiations
articles.standfirst: Pittsburgh could hijack Kansas City's plans to land 25-year-old Colts receiver
articles.summary: Pittsburgh could hijack Kansas City's plans to land 25-year-old Colts receiver
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs appear to have identified a potential solution to their wide receiver problems, but the Pittsburgh Steelers could complicate their efforts to acquire Indianapolis Colts receiver Josh Downs.

With both AFC contenders reportedly submitting offers, the race for the 25-year-old playmaker is heating up ahead of the November 10 NFL trade deadline.

According to NFL insider Evan Sidery, Kansas City and Pittsburgh have each offered Day 3 draft compensation for Downs . Indianapolis initially sought a third-round selection but could settle for a fourth- or fifth-round pick.

A deal is expected to gain momentum after the weekend, although neither interested franchise has reached an agreement.

Downs ' potential departure follows a reported trade request on October 28. Although the receiver hasn't revealed the full reasons behind his decision, his recent comments suggest he's prepared to move on from Indianapolis.

"I'm open to whatever. Whatever comes my way, comes my way and we go from there," Downs said.

Selected in the third round of the 2023 NFL Draft, Downs has accumulated 2,447 receiving yards across 54 career appearances. His route-running ability and effectiveness from the slot could make him a valuable addition for either contender.

Why Pittsburgh could complicate Kansas City's plans

Kansas City arguably has the stronger immediate need for another receiver. Injuries have significantly disrupted its receiving corps, while Xavier Worthy has struggled to deliver consistent production.

Adding Downs would give Patrick Mahomes another dependable underneath target and potentially improve the offense's ability to sustain drives.

The Chiefs have already seen their pursuit of another major receiving target encounter difficulties. New York Jets receiver Garrett Wilson had emerged as a potential option, but ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Saturday that the franchise has no intention of trading him before the deadline.

Wilson's four-year, $130 million extension, which runs through 2030, makes a departure particularly difficult. His availability would've given Kansas City an opportunity to make a significant statement, but Downs could represent a more realistic alternative.

Pittsburgh, meanwhile, has its own reasons for entering the negotiations. The Steelers could use another weapon to support veteran quarterback Aaron Rodgers , particularly with D.K. Metcalf carrying much of the receiving responsibility.

Although Metcalf leads the team, production behind him has been less convincing. Downs could provide Rodgers with a reliable target over the middle, helping Pittsburgh improve its passing attack during the closing stages of the season.

However, there's also a potential downside. The Steelers already have younger receivers, including Roman Wilson , who could benefit from additional opportunities. Bringing in Downs might complicate their development plans.

Indianapolis' rebuilding direction could ultimately determine the receiver's destination. Following general manager Chris Ballard's dismissal, the Colts have already traded Quenton Nelson and DeForest Buckner , signaling their willingness to collect future draft capital.

Downs remains on Indianapolis' roster and is expected to feature in the Week 8 game plan. However, with the trade deadline approaching, Kansas City and Pittsburgh have limited time to complete a deal.

articles.title: Andy Reid can’t hide his joy when Travis Kelce surprises him with a cheeseburger in the Chiefs’ locker room
articles.standfirst: Travis Kelce’s sneaker-box surprise gives the Kansas City coach exactly what he wants
articles.summary: Travis Kelce’s sneaker-box surprise gives the Kansas City coach exactly what he wants
articles.body:
Andy Reid gets a surprise in a new video posted by the Chiefs: Travis Kelce walks into the locker room with a wrapped box that looks like it could hold sneakers. But when Reid opens it, there’s a cheeseburger inside. The players celebrate as the coach smiles at the reveal, turning his favorite food into the punchline of the scene.

Patrick Mahomes also appears in the playful montage , with the quarterback and Kelce joining their teammates in the joke. The video lands because Reid’s affection for cheeseburgers is already familiar to Chiefs fans.

After Kansas City won the AFC Championship, Reid summed up his celebration with a memorable line: “I had a cheeseburger and went to bed.”

The Chiefs look to bounce back against the Broncos

The lighthearted moment comes as Kansas City prepares for a tough divisional matchup . The Chiefs are 5-1 after losing 20-3 to Seattle on Oct. 25, their first defeat of the season. They visit the Denver Broncos on Sunday, Nov. 1, at 3:25 p.m. CT, with the game airing on CBS. NFL.com

Kenneth Walker III has given Reid’s offense a powerful running option since joining the Chiefs this season. He has rushed for 701 yards and six touchdowns on 120 carries through six games.

Seattle held him to 36 yards in his return to face his former team, but his strong start has helped give Kansas City another way to move the ball.

Mahomes and Kelce remain the familiar connection at the heart of the offense: the Chiefs credit them with 59 touchdown connections, the most by a quarterback and pass catcher in franchise history.

Kelce was limited in practice with an ankle issue earlier in the week, but he practiced fully Friday and was cleared from the injury report for Denver.

Seattle held him to 36 yards in his return to face his former team, but his strong start has helped give Kansas City another way to move the ball.
Mahomes and Kelce remain the familiar connection at the heart of the offense: the Chiefs credit them with 59 touchdown connections, the most by a quarterback and pass catcher in franchise history.
Kelce was limited in practice with an ankle issue earlier in the week, but he practiced fully Friday and was cleared from the injury report for Denver.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes takes a break from the NFL to join Toy Story for Halloween
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs quarterback embraced this Saturday’s festivities by sharing a fun family tradition that has become a special annual occasion.
articles.summary: The Chiefs quarterback embraced this Saturday’s festivities by sharing a fun family tradition that has become a special annual occasion.
articles.body:
It’s Halloween, and while many families are getting their costumes ready to go trick-or-treating or celebrate the holiday, Patrick Mahomes has a special tradition of his own at home. The Kansas City Chiefs quarterback took a break from the demands of the NFL season to enjoy a family moment that quickly caught everyone's attention. This year, the inspiration came from a beloved movie that has captured the hearts of generations.

Patrick Mahomes and his family transform into Toy Story characters

Brittany Mahomes shared photos of the family's Halloween celebration on Saturday, October 31, showing everyone dressed up as characters from the Toy Story universe. Patrick stepped into the role of Buzz Lightyear, while Brittany transformed into Jessie, the spirited cowgirl from the movie .

The little ones also had their own parts to play in the adventure. Bronze Lavon Mahomes III dressed up as Woody, Golden wore a costume inspired by one of the little green aliens, and Sterling Skye Mahomes joined in as Barbie . Together, their coordinated costumes made the family look like they had stepped straight out of the beloved animated film.

This year's theme continues a tradition the family has shared with their followers on social media. In 2025, Patrick, Brittany, and their children went with the Spider-Man universe for Halloween . Patrick dressed as Miles Morales, Brittany took on the role of Aunt May, and the kids joined in with their own characters, including Spider-Gwen.

Patrick Mahomes returns to the NFL this Sunday to face the Broncos

After this fun and spooky Halloween break, Patrick Mahomes will turn his attention back to football. On Sunday, November 1, the Kansas City Chiefs will travel to Empower Field at Mile High to face the Denver Broncos in a Week 8 matchup with major implications for the AFC West standings.

The Chiefs enter the game with a 5-1 record, sitting atop the division despite coming off their first loss of the season . The Seattle Seahawks handed Kansas City a 20-3 defeat in their most recent outing. Meanwhile, Denver boasts a 5-2 record and is riding a three-game winning streak, putting the Broncos in a strong position to challenge their division rival for first place.

Sunday's matchup will also mark the second meeting between the two teams this season. Kansas City dominated their Week 1 encounter, securing a convincing 31-10 victory. However, the Broncos are in a very different position this time around and will look to take advantage of playing at home to turn the tables.

articles.title: Travis Kelce's neighbors are a major problem: The three points of contention regarding his $5.35 million Ohio mansion
articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift and Kelce’s planned changes have run into firm resistance in near Cleveland Heights
articles.summary: Taylor Swift and Kelce’s planned changes have run into firm resistance in near Cleveland Heights
articles.body:
Travis Kelce 's $5.35 million Ohio home has become the focus of a dispute that reaches beyond the boundaries of his estate as neighbors have challenged proposed landscaping work, forcing the Kansas City Chiefs star's plans before the village's architectural review board. The objections concern three things: the removal and replacement of trees, the risk of disturbing a century-old shared sewer line, and whether the new planting would exceed local height restrictions at Bratenahl .

The board has postponed a decision whilst plans are revised and the disagreement is an unwelcome complication for the tight end, whose purchase brought him back close to Cleveland Heights , where he grew up as he prepares for life after retirement from the NFL . His attempt to settle near his hometown now faces a review process shaped partly by concerns from surrounding homeowners and one point of friction is the proposal to remove trees at the rear of the property as locals are concerned that work could affect their views towards Lake Erie . Making the landscaping plan a concern beyond Kelce 's own grounds, neighbors have also questioned what the work could mean for the shared sewer line as the concern is that construction or landscaping could damage the infrastructure, adding a practical issue to the debate. The final objection is the height of the replacement trees as local regulations set a maximum of 10 feet, and the original proposal did not meet that requirement whilst Kelce and Taylor Swift argue it is necessary to maintain their privacy and security from unwanted visitors. The board has requested an amended plan before considering approval and the project remains unresolved, with officials expected to revisit the application at their November 10 meeting. Kelce will have an opportunity to submit changes addressing the objections raised by nearby residents and bringing the plans into line with village regulations.

Kelce prepares for the Chiefs' matchup against Denver

Away from the property dispute, Kelce has been cleared to play against the Denver Broncos after participating fully in Friday's practice in a massive boost for the Chiefs at the Empower Field at Mile High in Colorado . The Kansas City catcher was not included on the injury report, easing concerns about his availability for the divisional matchup as the 5-1 Chiefs can essentially wrap up the division with a victory over the 5-2 Broncos , which could prove vital when it comes to resting for the NFL Playoffs . Kelce had sustained an ankle injury against the Los Angeles Chargers in Week 6 and was limited during Thursday's session after practicing fully on Wednesday but his return to unrestricted participation on Friday provided a positive update ahead of the game. Despite the defeat to the Seattle Seahawks , Kelce 's four receptions for 44 yards took his career receiving total, including playoff games, to 15,432 yards, the highest figure recorded by a tight end. His 1104 career receptions also place him fifth on the all-time list.

articles.title: Kansas City Chiefs vs Denver Broncos: Where to watch Travis Kelce and Patrick Mahomes today and what time the game is at Mile High
articles.standfirst: High-altitude showdown at Mile High: the Broncos host Chiefs looking to bounce back
articles.summary: High-altitude showdown at Mile High: the Broncos host Chiefs looking to bounce back
articles.body:
This Sunday, November 1, 2026, t he hottest rivalry in the AFC West heats up once again. In NFL Week 8 this season , the Denver Broncos host the Kansas City Chiefs at Empower Field at Mile High in Denver, which has a capacity of 76,125 fans.

Beyond the historical intrigue, something concrete is at stake: the lead in the AFC West . The Chiefs come in as the leaders of that group with a 5-1 record, while the Broncos are right behind them at 5-2.

A home win would tie things up at the top of the West; an away victory would leave Kansas City with a gap that would be hard to close. Rarely does a Week 8 game carry so much weight in the divisional race.

Where to watch today's Chiefs vs Broncos and what time does it start?

The opening whistle is scheduled for 4:25 p.m. Eastern Time (3:25 p.m. Central Time and 1:25 p.m. Pacific Time) this Sunday, November 1, 2026, at Empower Field at Mile High in Denver, home of the Broncos.

Regarding the broadcast in the United States, you will be able to watch the game through:

Streaming: Fubo, Paramount+, Hulu + Live TV, or YouTube TV

Kansas City Chiefs vs Denver Broncos: Match Overview

Denver arrives on a roll. After falling in the season opener, the home team has become a win-collecting machine : it is coming off a string of important victories, and in Week 7 it steamrolled the Arizona Cardinals 30-16 on the road.

Earlier, they had also won close contests against Seattle and the Chargers, in addition to a thrilling 30-26 victory over the Rams. Through seven games, they have scored 144 points and allowed 141: narrow margins that speak of a team that knows how to win one-possession games.

Kansas City, for its part, comes in with a thorn in its side. Its five-game winning streak was snapped in Week 7 , when it suffered a decisive 3-20 road loss to the Seattle Seahawks.

It was, by far, their worst offensive afternoon of the year: just 3 points for an offense accustomed to pulling out close games, like that 33-30 win over Indianapolis or the 30-27 victory in Las Vegas. The Chiefs' defense remains the team's best calling card: only 103 points allowed in six games, the lowest total in the entire AFC.

Chiefs vs Broncos under the microscope: recent history and key players

You don’t have to look far to gauge this rivalry: these same teams already faced off in Week 1 of this season, and the Chiefs won convincingly 31-10 at home.

That result set the tone for Kansas City's campaign and left Denver needing to reinvent itself. The Broncos did just that, and now they have the perfect opportunity to get revenge in front of their fans, in Denver's altitude, where visitors always struggle to breathe.

On the home side of the offense, the spotlight is on 26-year-old quarterback Bo Nix, tasked with leading an attack that has become reliable in pressure moments. He has plenty of weapons: veteran wide receiver Courtland Sutton, explosive Jaylen Waddle, and tight end Evan Engram give Nix targets for every area of the field. In the running game, J.K. Dobbins provides the balance that keeps any defense honest.

On the other side, the story has a first and last name: Patrick Mahomes, the architect of the Kansas City dynasty. Around him revolve the dangerous Rashee Rice, the pure speed of Xavier Worthy and, of course, the ageless tight end Travis Kelce, 37, who remains Mahomes' favorite safety valve on third down.

In the backfield, Kenneth Walker III gives the Chiefs a rushing engine that will look to neutralize the strong defense Denver has shown in recent weeks.

Implications in the race for the AFC West lead

The impact of this game goes beyond the AFC West. In the overall American Conference standings, Kansas City holds first place at 5-1, while Denver appears fifth at 5-2, right in the thick of the fight for postseason berths.

A Broncos victory would not only level the divisional race, but also catapult them into the conversation for a top spot in the AFC playoff seeding. For the Chiefs, winning would mean keeping control of their destiny and putting the Seattle stumble behind them before it turns into a bigger slump.

Chiefs vs Broncos Prediction: Who Is the Favorite in Week 8?

Kansas City has the best defense in the American Conference and the most influential player on the gridiron , but it comes in banged up and visits one of the toughest venues in the league. Denver, on the other hand, is going through its best stretch of the season and plays with the extra motivation of returning the blow from the 31-10 result in Week 1.

It looks set to be a close game, decided by one possession in the final minutes—exactly the kind of contest the Broncos have dominated in 2026. Prediction: Denver Broncos by a narrow margin, with the Chiefs fighting until their last breath at Mile High.

articles.title: Will Taylor Swift be at the Chiefs vs Broncos game? This is what we know about her possible attendance today
articles.standfirst: Swift attended the previous meeting at the Arrowhead Stadium in Week 1
articles.summary: Swift attended the previous meeting at the Arrowhead Stadium in Week 1
articles.body:
Taylor Swift 's presence at Kansas City Chiefs games has become one of the NFL 's most recognizable celebrity storylines since her relationship with Travis Kelce became public and attention now turns to whether she will travel to Denver for Sunday's meeting with the Broncos on November 1. Swift has attended several important moments in Kelce 's Chiefs career, including Super Bowl appearances and regular-season fixtures as her appearances have also brought an entertainment audience to the NFL , with television cameras frequently showing her reactions from the stands.

The connection began when Kelce attended Swift 's Eras Tour concert at Arrowhead Stadium as he later explained that he had hoped to give the singer a friendship bracelet with his phone number. However, did not get the opportunity before he subsequently invited her to a Chiefs game in a bid to secure a second chance at linking up with the 37-year-old billionaire. Swift accepted and her first appearance came in September 2023, when Kansas City faced the Chicago Bears and she soon became a familiar figure at Arrowhead . Often watching alongside friends and family, as her relationship with the tight end blossomed, Swift is typically spotted in the VIP suites on gameday having become a football fanatic.

Will Taylor Swift attend Chiefs vs Broncos on November 1?

Swift attended the Chiefs ' September 14 season opener against the Broncos in Kansas City as she watched alongside Tom Cruise , marking her first time seeing Kelce play since their wedding earlier in the year and she also appeared at the clash with the Indianapolis Colts in Week 2. That appearance followed a significant personal milestone as Swift and Kelce married on July 3 in New York City , with Adam Sandler officiating with Taylor ’s brother, Austin , serving as her Man of Honor, while Travis ’ brother Jason served as Best Man. Swift has continued to support Kelce since the wedding as she was also at Arrowhead for Kansas City 's October 18 game against the Chargers , sitting Caitlin Clark as the Chiefs recorded a 22-6 victory. But her attendance at the November 1 game remains unconfirmed at Empower Field at Mile High , with the clash being a road fixture rather than one of the home appearances that have featured prominently in her recent schedule in Missouri . Her recent travel record offers less encouragement for those expecting to see her in Denver, as the singer was absent from Kansas City 's October 4 road game against the Las Vegas Raiders in Nevada and its October 25 trip to face the Seattle Seahawks in Washington . Those absences have strengthened the impression that Arrowhead is her preferred setting for watching Kelce as security considerations have previously been cited as a possible reason for favoring a familiar stadium where arrangements can be assessed and managed. Although attending in Denver cannot be ruled out, there is currently no reliable confirmation that she will make the trip. Swift was present when the Chiefs welcomed the Broncos , but this time she may remain at home watching her husband from the comfort of her living room.
